title: A Horizon for the Rivergate
author: Paloma Thackeray
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
